rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the tendency or quality of being easy to change.

example.english: The mutability of this industry is very high, and you may not keep up even after working in it for years.
example.traditional: 呢個行業嘅易變性好高，做幾年都未必跟得上。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hong4 jip6 ge3 ji6 bin3 sing3 hou2 gou1 zou6 gei2 nin4 dou1 mei6 bit1 gan1 dak1 soeng5

rows.note: Use this more formal term when discussing whether something is capable of being changed, especially in technical or written contexts.

example.english: This report analyzes the mutability of the virus's genes.
example.traditional: 呢份報告分析咗病毒基因嘅可變性。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 fan1 sik1 zo2 beng6 duk6 gei1 jan1 ge3 ho2 bin3 sing3
